name: ffhq
source: Flickr-Faces-HQ (Karras, Laine, Aila, NVIDIA, CVPR 2019; https://github.com/NVlabs/ffhq-dataset). images256/: 70,000 PNG 256x256 (downscaled from the official 1024x1024 aligned images) from the third-party HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/pravsels/FFHQ_256 (revision fcb28f9e140dfcf914b8b2f129cbe9eebd94cd79, raw/shard_{1..14}_of_14.zip, sha256 = HF LFS oids, archives/SHA256SUMS_raw.txt). archives/ffhq-dataset-v2.json (official metadata: Flickr URL, author, per-image licence) and thumbnails128x128.zip are from the official release; LICENSE.txt is the official licence file.
license: Dataset (JSON metadata, documentation, compilation): CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by NVIDIA - NON-COMMERCIAL, share-alike, attribution. Individual images keep their Flickr licences (ffhq-dataset-v2.json counts over the 70,000 images: Attribution 34,874, Attribution-NonCommercial 29,158, Public Domain Mark 4,487, CC0 1,144, U.S. Government Work 337); LICENSE.txt: 'All of these licenses allow free use, redistribution, and adaptation for non-commercial purposes.' The 256px HF mirror carries no licence of its own.

counts.used_by: E2 gallery distractors (1 template each) and non-mated probes (seeded 50/50 split by image)

notes: Non-celebrity Flickr photos: much less likely to overlap the recognizers' celebrity-based training identities than CelebA (overlap with WebFace/Glint cannot be excluded). Identity uniqueness is NOT guaranteed (the same person can appear in several images), so an FFHQ 'false positive' may occasionally be a true match. Faces are FFHQ-aligned (dlib 68 landmarks, 1024 crop) at 256 px; E2 re-detects them with SCRFD (largest face) and re-aligns to the ArcFace template. E2 usage: 369 images that match a CelebA identity centroid (4-model consensus cosine >= 0.45; celebrities) were dropped; probes and distractors are split by Flickr account (photo_url, 14,953 accounts for 70,000 images) so a person repeated within one account never sits on both sides; residual same-person pairs across accounts and many infants/children remain, so FFHQ is a secondary non-mated pool (reports/E2_1N). SCRFD-34G found a face in 69,989 / 70,000.
